game_concept: A adventure race set in Snowy Hold – Ice Market, a market under icicles: the snow ranger must handle blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Library Builder: Combine small functions into a reusable library the snow ranger calls throughout the level.
theme: Snowy Hold – Ice Market: a market under icicles
core_gameplay_loop: In Ice Market, repeat each round: Combine small functions into a reusable library the snow ranger calls throughout the level. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the snow ranger ahead. Then check the library value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the hold gate by solving code steps involving library that move the snow ranger forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the hold gate first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 6 (applied tier): Library Builder
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Library Builder' (Week 6 slot 14), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Ice Market'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how library changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against blizzard sprites in Ice Market.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
